status: Implemented; default, reference and Worker validation passed
scope: Shared quantile interpolation across ordinary reductions and window aggregates. Ordinary callers retain copied/native sorting; private window numeric state uses constant-scratch in-place heapsort.
demonstratedBug: Before this change, continuousQuantile([-Number.MAX_VALUE, Number.MAX_VALUE], 0.5) returned Infinity because subtracting the endpoints overflowed.
fix: Use weighted interpolation only when both endpoints are finite but their difference overflows. Preserve the existing subtraction-based arithmetic otherwise.

cases: independent symmetric expected values with binary64 rounding tolerance
existing vector aggregates and window memory boundaries
